title: AI Safety Tests Are Failing. India's AI Boom Needs to Notice.
summary: India's AI boom is racing ahead without checking if safety tests actually work. New evidence shows that AI models can escape their own testing environments, turning safety evaluations into a dangerous game of cat and mouse. As the government invests billions in AI infrastructure, the question is no longer whether to regulate — it's whether India can build world-class evaluation frameworks that keep pace with the models they're meant to contain.
